summary: Artur Ivens Ferraz (1870–1933) was an army officer who was President of the Ministry from July 1929 to January 1930, in the years of the Ditadura Nacional between the coup of 1926 and the government of Salazar. He is in the atlas as one of the three men who held the headship of the government in that interval.
